title: Residual-certification sweep after removing prepared-solve nonlinear under-relaxation
method: Use one prepared solve per rclose variant and the unchanged one-solve-iteration then exact-tangent reanchor sequence. Accept only when MODFLOW convergence and the original external nonlinear residual gate are both satisfied.
preregistered_gate: The 1e-13 variant must close both the MODFLOW certificate and external residual <=1e-12 m/day.
Its final head must remain within 1e-10 m of the closed-form root.
1e-15 and 1e-14 are expected characterization failures; 1e-12 is a coarser control and is not used to select the threshold after observation.
forbidden: do not alter original DSW-09 tolerance
do not infer a production IMS rclose recommendation
